verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review product with a fix agent that pushes commits, so a configurable cloud environment for its agents is a fair question. However, the evidence never documents environment, dependency, or setup-step configuration. cubic.yaml covers only review behavior, ignore patterns, PR descriptions and custom agents, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure a reproducible cloud environment with the dependencies and setup steps my repository needs
